lines.en: label rindorm45:
: I’m home!
lines.zh: : 我回来了！

lines.en: Rin throws the door open and calls out to absolutely no one.
lines.zh: Rin 一把拉开门，对着根本不存在的人喊了一声。

lines.en: She doesn’t step aside to let me in or make any other sort of polite gesture, just treats it like it’s any other day because-
lines.zh: 她没有侧身让我进去，也没有做出任何客气的表示，只当这是再平常不过的一天——

lines.en: Well, it {i}is{/i} any other day.
lines.zh: 因为，这本来{i}就是{/i}再平常不过的一天。

lines.en: Every day is just another day and there is no single day any better or worse than the next.
lines.zh: 每一天都只是又一天，没有哪一天比另一天更好或者更糟。

lines.en: They will all blend together- and we will all {i}fall{/i} together.
lines.zh: 它们会全部融在一起——而我们也会一起{i}坠落{/i}。

lines.en: Or will we?
lines.zh: 还是不会呢？

lines.en: scene rindormfortyfive1
: Baaaaah...I’m beat.
lines.zh: : 啊啊啊……累死我了。

lines.en: : Who would have thought walking six million miles would take that much out of you?
lines.zh: : 谁会想到走六百万英里会这么要命？

lines.en: : Everyone. Everyone would think that.
lines.zh: : 所有人。所有人都会想到。

lines.en: scene rindormfortyfive2
: Rhetorical question, good sir. I obviously know how legs work. I’m on them all day every day.
lines.zh: : 修辞性提问，好先生。我当然知道腿是怎么运作的。我天天都靠它们站着。

lines.en: : Except for when I’m kicking your ass at video games and {i}railing the shit out of you.{/i}
lines.zh: : 除了打游戏把你按在地上摩擦、{i}狠狠干爆你{/i}的时候。

lines.en: : You really like that euphemism, don’t you?
lines.zh: : 你真的很喜欢这个委婉说法，是吧？

lines.en: : Oh, hell yeah. One of the several cool things about you coming instead of Otoha today was that I didn’t have to prevent myself from saying weird stuff like that.
lines.zh: : 哦，那当然。今天来的是你而不是 Otoha，几件爽事之一就是我不用憋着不说这种怪话。

lines.en: : Otoha’s cool but even she’d probably be like, “Woah, chill” if I came out and talked about railing her all of a sudden.
lines.zh: : Otoha 是很酷，但我敢说，就算她听到我突然说什么干她，大概也会是「哇，冷静点」。

lines.en: : Speaking of which, how are things going with her? I noticed you pulling out your phone pretty frequently on the ride back.
lines.zh: : 说到这个，你跟她进展怎么样？回来的路上我注意到你老掏手机。

lines.en: scene rindormfortyfive3
: Uhh...hard to tell. I don’t think she has her phone back.
lines.zh: : 呃……不好说。我觉得她手机还没拿回来。

lines.en: : Only reason I kept pulling it out was to check if she’s alive again yet.
lines.zh: : 我一直掏出来，就是为了看看她是不是又「活」过来了。

lines.en: : Not having a phone does not equate to being dead, you know.
lines.zh: : 没有手机不等于死了，你知道吧。

lines.en: scene rindormfortyfive4
: Try saying that to literally any [teenage]girl with a crush and see what they say, Sensei.
lines.zh: : Sensei，你随便找一个暗恋中的 [teenage]女孩说这话试试看。

lines.en: : Guarantee you that they’ll all say it’s basically the same thing.
lines.zh: : 我保证她们全都会说，那基本就是一回事。

lines.en: : I can’t imagine there being anything that could be taken away from me that would make me-
lines.zh: : 我想象不出有什么东西被夺走会让我——

lines.en: : Imagine all of the girls in your life were suddenly replaced with boys.
lines.zh: : 想象一下你生活里所有女生突然全变成男生。

lines.en: : Oh. Yeah, you clearly know me better than I know myself. That sounds horrible.
lines.zh: : 哦。好吧，你确实比我自己更了解我。听上去太可怕了。

lines.en: scene rindormfortyfive5
: Course I do. I see you almost as much as I see Futaba now.
lines.zh: : 那当然。现在我见你的次数都快赶上见 Futaba 了。

lines.en: : Like, I’m sure you could see plenty of things about me that I can’t see even if I try.
lines.zh: : 就是说，肯定有很多我自己看不出来的东西，你一眼就能看到。

lines.en: : Like how awkward I apparently am when it comes to talking to cute girls.
lines.zh: : 比如我跟可爱女生说话时到底有多笨拙。

lines.en: : You should give me some pointers one day. Maybe even become my wingman.
lines.zh: : 哪天你该教教我。甚至当我的僚机也行。

lines.en: : I don’t think I’d be a very good wingman.
lines.zh: : 我觉得我不会是个好僚机。

lines.en: : Why? Cause everyone magically falls for you without you even doing anything?
lines.zh: : 为什么？因为所有人都像中了魔似的，你什么都不做就爱上你了？

lines.en: : Not {i}everyone{/i}.
lines.zh: : 也不是{i}所有人。{/i}

lines.en: : There’s one girl I know who had the audacity to call me a backup date today. What’s up with that?
lines.zh: : 我就认识一个女生，今天居然有脸叫我「备用约会」。这是怎么回事？

lines.en: if rinbetrayed == True:
: Are you forgetting that you fingered my first major crush?
lines.zh: : 你是不是忘了，你用手指弄过我第一个真正喜欢的人？

lines.en: : Sorry for not prioritizing you, all things considered.
lines.zh: : 综上所述，没把你排在第一位，抱歉啊。

lines.en: : Apology accepted.
lines.zh: : 接受你的道歉。

lines.en: : Unreal.
lines.zh: : 真是离谱。

lines.en: else:
: Hey, I’ve been with you all day. I know exactly who you’re talking about.
lines.zh: : 嘿，我一整天都跟你在一起。我当然知道你在说谁。

lines.en: : If it’s any consolation, you were the best backup I’ve ever had.
lines.zh: : 如果这能让你好受点的话，你是我有过的最好的备胎。

lines.en: : To be fair, though, I can count every date I’ve ever had on one hand.
lines.zh: : 不过说句公道话，我约会过的次数一只手就数得过来。

lines.en: : But yeah-
lines.zh: : 但是呢——

lines.en: : I think it’s safe to say that, if nothing else, you’ve earned yourself a special place in the memories I will one day share with my adopted children.
lines.zh: 我觉得可以这么说，至少你在将来某天我会讲给我领养的孩子们听的回忆里，赢得了一个特别的位置。

lines.en: : Adopted?
lines.zh: : 领养？

lines.en: : So you don’t see yourself ever starting a family with a male?
lines.zh: : 所以你不觉得自己会跟一个男的组成家庭？

lines.en: : I never said that.
lines.zh: : 我可从没说过。

lines.en: : Who knows? Maybe a few years from now I’ll start prioritizing men over women and everything will change.
lines.zh: : 谁知道呢？说不定几年后我就开始把男人排在女人前面，一切都会变。

lines.en: : You can still adopt when you’re in a heterosexual relationship, Sensei. There's no rule against that.
lines.zh: : Sensei，你就算是异性恋关系也可以领养啊。又没规定不行。

lines.en: : I'm probably not one to talk since both of {i}my{/i} parents are girls, but hey. There are exceptions.
lines.zh: : 我大概也没什么资格说这话，因为{i}我{/i}爸妈都是女的，不过嘛。总会有例外的。

lines.en: : Wait, what?
lines.zh: : 等等，什么？

lines.en: : Oh, right. I forgot to tell you that I’m adopted.
lines.zh: : 哦，对了。我忘了告诉你我是领养的了。

lines.en: : Surprise!
lines.zh: : 惊喜吧！

lines.en: : How are you going to just casually drop that sort of bombshell on me?
lines.zh: : 你怎么能这么随口就扔出这种重磅炸弹？

lines.en: scene rindormfortyfive6
: Bombshell?
lines.zh: : 重磅炸弹？

lines.en: : I don’t really think it changes much about me.
lines.zh: : 我觉得这也没怎么改变我这个人。

lines.en: : I would have turned out the same way I am with or {i}without{/i} being adopted.
lines.zh: : 不管有{i}没有{/i}被领养，我都会长成现在这样。

lines.en: : It’s just part of who I am.
lines.zh: : 这只是我的一部分。

lines.en: : {i}And{/i} I get the added benefit of being able to blame all of my mental issues on my biological parents since my adoptive ones are totally free of all that.
lines.zh: : {i}而且{/i}还有个好处，我可以把所有的心理问题都甩锅给亲生父母，因为养父母那边完全没这些毛病。

lines.en: : It's just really surprising hearing this out of nowhere.
lines.zh: : 只是突然听到这个真的很意外。

lines.en: scene rindormfortyfive7
: Listen, man, I’ll gladly go into more detail if you want, but can we sit down first?
lines.zh: : 听着，老兄，你想听细节我当然乐意讲，但能不能先坐下？

lines.en: : My feet are kinda killing me and my new bed is friggin’ soft as hell. I’ve been thinking about it all day long.
lines.zh: : 我的脚快疼死了，而且我的新床软得要命。我惦记一整天了。

lines.en: : Oh, sure. Yeah.
lines.zh: : 哦，当然。好啊。

lines.en: : Feel free to join me if you’d like!
lines.zh: : 你想一起坐也行！

lines.en: : Or just stand around and look weird. That’s fine, too.
lines.zh: : 或者就站在这儿发呆也行。那也没问题。

lines.en: scene black
Rin unstraps her shoes and tosses them against the wall, causing Futaba’s bookshelf to shake.
lines.zh: Rin 解开鞋带，把鞋往墙上一甩，震得 Futaba 的书架都晃了。

lines.en: Thankfully, no books were harmed in the process and they will all live to see another day.
lines.zh: 所幸没有书在这个过程中受伤，它们全都活到了下一天。

lines.en: Another day that is no better nor worse than every other.
lines.zh: 又一个不比任何一天更好、也不比任何一天更糟的一天。

lines.en: scene rindormfortyfive8
: Okay! The floor is now open to any cliche adoption questions you may have.
lines.zh: : 好了！现在开放提问，关于领养的老套问题随便来。

lines.en: : Hit me with your best shot.
lines.zh: : 尽管放马过来。

lines.en: Right.
lines.zh: 对。

lines.en: I’m sure she’s already gone over everything I could possibly ask her a thousand times before.
lines.zh: 我敢肯定，我可能问的那些问题她早就回答过一千遍了。

lines.en: But in order to sate my curiosity, I kind of {i}have{/i} to be a little cliche.
lines.zh: 但为了满足我的好奇心，我{i}不得不{/i}老套一点。

lines.en: I’ve spent so much time with this girl now and, if I don’t even know anything about her past, do I really know anything about her at all?
lines.zh: 我跟这个女孩已经相处了这么久，如果连她的过去都一无所知，那我到底算了解她什么？

lines.en: Who we are in the present is a direct result of our upbringing and experience.
lines.zh: 我们现在的样子，是成长经历和过往经验直接造就的。

lines.en: And all I know is the present version of Rin.
lines.zh: 而我认识的只是现在这个 Rin。

lines.en: So I let the cliche questions roll.
lines.zh: 于是我让那些老套问题一个接一个地冒出来。

lines.en: : How much do you know about your biological parents?
lines.zh: : 你对亲生父母了解多少？

lines.en: : All I {i}really{/i} know is that they didn’t love me enough to keep me.
lines.zh: : 我{i}只{/i}知道他们爱我爱得不够，所以没留下我。

lines.en: : I remember hearing something about how my mom was kind of insane and that my dad was a huge cheat who didn’t want to be burdened by a kid or something.
lines.zh: : 我记得听到过一些说法，说我妈有点疯，我爸是个超级花心的混蛋，不想被孩子拖累什么的。

lines.en: : But, then again, that’s just what other kids in the orphanage said. And you know how that sort of thing goes.
lines.zh: : 不过话说回来，那也都是孤儿院里别的孩子说的。你知道这种事是怎么回事。

lines.en: : I don’t, but if it’s anything like kids {i}outside{/i} of orphanages, I’m sure they were just trying to pick fights with you or something.
lines.zh: : 我不知道，但如果跟孤儿院{i}外面{/i}的孩子差不多的话，我猜他们大概就是想找茬跟你打架什么的。

lines.en: : Yeah, pretty much.
lines.zh: : 差不多吧。

lines.en: : Anything else you wanna know?
lines.zh: : 你还想知道别的吗？

lines.en: : I’ll tell you in advance that I don’t have any brothers or sisters.
lines.zh: : 提前告诉你，我没有兄弟姐妹。

lines.en: : You’re an only child?
lines.zh: : 你是独生女？

lines.en: : You betcha. No one’s takin’ any of {i}my{/i} old clothes or going through my closet or other stuff big sisters have to deal with.
lines.zh: : 那还用说。没人会捡{i}我的{/i}旧衣服穿，也没人会翻我的衣柜，或者别的那些姐姐们要操心的事。

lines.en: : Did it ever feel strange?
lines.zh: : 有没有觉得奇怪过？

lines.en: : The only child part or the adopted part?
lines.zh: : 独生女那部分，还是被领养那部分？

lines.en: : ...Both?
lines.zh: : ……都有吧？

lines.en: scene rindormfortyfive9
: That’s another thing I don’t understand why people ask.
lines.zh: : 这也是我不明白别人为什么要问的又一个问题。

lines.en: : Like, obviously it felt strange. But it also kind of...didn’t.
lines.zh: : 就好比，当然觉得奇怪过。但又好像……也没那么奇怪。

lines.en: : My parents have always been really supportive of me and never made me do anything I didn’t want to do.
lines.zh: : 我爸妈一直很支持我，从来没逼我做我不想做的事。

lines.en: : Except that one time with the swimming pool.
lines.zh: : 除了游泳池那次。

lines.en: : The...what?
lines.zh: : 什么……什么？

lines.en: : Doesn’t matter.
lines.zh: : 没什么。

lines.en: : Either way, they’re good parents.
lines.zh: : 总之，他们是好父母。

lines.en: : And I’m pretty sure they noticed my depression before even I did since they threw me into therapy before I even thought I needed it.
lines.zh: : 而且我敢肯定，他们比我更早注意到我的抑郁症，因为在我自己觉得需要之前，他们就把我塞进了心理治疗。

lines.en: : Granted, it wasn’t really helpful. But at least they {i}tried{/i}, you know?
lines.zh: : 当然，也没什么用。但至少他们{i}试过{/i}了，你懂吧？

lines.en: scene rindormfortyfive10
: Anything else? Or can I start learning things about you now?
lines.zh: : 还有别的吗？还是说现在轮到我来了解你了？

lines.en: : I’ll stop bothering you with cliche adoption questions, but I’m not sure how much I’ll be able to tell you about myself.
lines.zh: : 我不拿老套的领养问题烦你了，但我不确定自己能告诉你多少关于我的事。

lines.en: : Why’s that?
lines.zh: : 为什么？

lines.en: : Are you actually an isekai protag who got tossed into Kumon-mi after getting hit by a truck or something?
lines.zh: : 你其实是个被卡车撞了之后被扔进 Kumon-mi 的异世界主角吧？

lines.en: : Suicide, actually.
lines.zh: : 是自杀，其实。

lines.en: : Ahh, yes. Another popular excuse to show up in another world.
lines.zh: : 啊，对。又是个穿越到异世界的热门借口。

lines.en: : Does your place of origin have elves? I’ve always thought elves were hot.
lines.zh: : 你原来那个世界有精灵吗？我一直觉得精灵很性感。

lines.en: : There were no elves, no.
lines.zh: : 没有精灵，没有。

lines.en: : Damn.
scene rindormfortyfive11
: I’m obviously not gonna make you tell me anything if you don’t want to.
lines.zh: : 你不想说，我当然不会逼你说。

lines.en: : I just thought it would be kind of cool to learn more about you one of these days.
lines.zh: : 我只是觉得，哪天能多了解你一点会挺酷的。

lines.en: : And I’d gladly tell you if I could.
lines.zh: : 如果可以的话，我也很乐意告诉你。

lines.en: : I just...have memory issues or something?
lines.zh: : 只是……我有记忆问题之类的？

lines.en: : Damn. Another good example of isekai syndrome. I thought you didn’t read manga, Sensei?
lines.zh: : 靠。又一个异世界综合征的典型症状。我以为你不看漫画呢，Sensei？

lines.en: It’s obviously understandable why she wouldn’t believe any of this.
lines.zh: 她不相信这些，显然很正常。

lines.en: But what’s the proper way to tell someone that you can’t remember your childhood?
lines.zh: 但要怎么跟别人说，你不记得自己的童年？

lines.en: Should I blame it on trauma despite the complete and utter lack of what that trauma would even have been?
lines.zh: 该把锅甩给创伤吗，尽管我完全说不出那创伤到底是什么？

lines.en: Of course not. That’s not fair to people who actually went through horrible things.
lines.zh: 当然不行。那对真正经历过可怕事情的人不公平。

lines.en: Things that changed their lives.
lines.zh: 那些改变了他们一生的事。

lines.en: It’s like mine was just erased one day.
lines.zh: 就好像我的过去某天被人直接抹掉了一样。

lines.en: And my consciousness was injected into someone else.
lines.zh: 然后我的意识被注射进了别人的身体。

lines.en: What an annoyingly unlucky situation for everyone involved.
lines.zh: 对所有相关的人来说，这都是个烦人又不走运的状况。

lines.en: scene rindormfortyfive12
: So, background info aside, did you have fun today?
lines.zh: : 好了，背景信息就到这儿，今天玩得开心吗？

lines.en: : Did it seem like something Otoha might enjoy?
lines.zh: : 看着像是 Otoha 也会喜欢的事吗？

lines.en: : Maybe I should just test all of my date ideas on you beforehand?
lines.zh: : 要不我以后把自己的约会点子先在你身上试一遍？

lines.en: : You can be my guinea pig in both love {i}and{/i} coffee.
lines.zh: : 你在爱情{i}和{/i}咖啡这两件事上，都可以当我的小白鼠。

lines.en: : I don’t know much about Otoha, but if someone like me was able to have fun, I’m sure she would have enjoyed it as well.
lines.zh: : 我不太了解 Otoha，但连我这样的人都能玩得开心，她应该也会喜欢。

lines.en: scene rindormfortyfive13
: If only she didn’t stand me up.
lines.zh: : 要是她没放我鸽子就好了。

lines.en: : I don’t think she was actually standing you up. She just has strict parents. You said it yourself.
lines.zh: : 我觉得她不算放你鸽子。她只是父母管得严。你自己也这么说过。

lines.en: : Besides, I don’t think she would have stopped by the cafe just to hang out with you if she wasn’t at least interested in being friends.
lines.zh: : 再说，如果她对你连交朋友都不感兴趣，肯定不会专门来咖啡厅找你玩。

lines.en: : Right! And friends is...all I want to be right now anyway.
lines.zh: : 对！而且朋友……就是我现在想要的全部。

lines.en: : Even if I kept calling it a date and openly admitted to thinking she’s super pretty and how I want to tie the lesbian tongue knot with her.
lines.zh: : 就算我一直管这叫约会，还公开说她超级漂亮、想跟她系上女同性恋的舌头结。

lines.en: : Like, I could drop her right away if I-
lines.zh: : 就是说，我可以立刻把她甩掉，如果我——

lines.en: scene rindormfortyfive14
Rin’s phone suddenly beeps and she’s able to pull it out of her pocket so quickly that I don’t even remember watching her reach for it.
lines.zh: Rin 的手机突然响了一声，她掏手机的速度快得我都没反应过来她是什么时候伸手去拿的。

lines.en: : Ah! Otoha got her phone back!
lines.zh: : 啊！Otoha 拿回手机了！

lines.en: : What were you saying about being able to drop her?
lines.zh: : 你刚才说能立刻把她甩掉什么来着？

lines.en: : What? I have no idea what you’re talking about.
lines.zh: : 什么？我完全不知道你在说什么。

lines.en: if rinbetrayed == True:
Rin spends the next several minutes sending a barrage of text messages to her friend as I sit there and ponder over what it would be like to be on the receiving end of them.
lines.zh: 接下来的几分钟里，Rin 噼里啪啦地给她的朋友发了一连串短信，我坐在那儿琢磨着，要是收短信的人是我会是什么感觉。

lines.en: In a world like this, where everyone except for a few girls shower me with affection every moment of every day-
lines.zh: 在这样一个世界里，除了几个女生之外，所有人每时每刻都在把爱意往我身上倒——

lines.en: Having someone I can be this close with {i}and{/i} this far away from at the exact same time is...
lines.zh: 能有一个人跟我这么近，{i}同时又{/i}这么远，这种感觉……

lines.en: Weird.
lines.zh: 很怪。

lines.en: I don’t think I like it.
lines.zh: 我觉得我不喜欢。

lines.en: I want to move forward with Rin, but of course she doesn’t want to move forward with me.
lines.zh: 我想跟 Rin 往前走，可她当然不想跟我往前走。

lines.en: Not after I went behind her back and “stole” the last girl she was interested in.
lines.zh: 毕竟我背着她「抢走」了她上一个喜欢的人。

lines.en: Hell, she still admires Chika so much that I’m positive she’d stop this whole pursuit of Otoha if Chika even {i}hinted{/i} at wanting something more with her.
lines.zh: 天啊，她到现在还是那么仰慕 Chika，我敢肯定只要 Chika 稍微{i}暗示{/i}想跟她更进一步，她就会放弃对 Otoha 的这番追求。

lines.en: But obviously nothing like that is going to happen-
lines.zh: 但显然那种事不会发生——

lines.en: Because Chika is mine. And Chika is only interested in {i}being{/i} mine.
lines.zh: 因为 Chika 是我的。而 Chika 只想{i}成为{/i}我的人。

lines.en: There was never any room for Rin to be involved in that.
lines.zh: 这里面从来没有 Rin 插足的余地。

lines.en: Just like there was never any room for me to be involved with her.
lines.zh: 就像我从来也没有插足她的余地一样。

lines.en: : Okay, I think it’s about time for me to head out.
lines.zh: : 好了，我差不多该走了。

lines.en: scene rindormfortyfive15
: Ah, shoot! I’m sorry!
lines.zh: : 啊，糟了！对不起！

lines.en: : I was just so excited to hear back from her that I zoned out for a bit.
lines.zh: : 我太兴奋了，一走神就忘了时间。

lines.en: : It’s okay, I’ll tell her I-
lines.zh: : 没关系，我告诉她我——

lines.en: : It’s fine. It’s getting kind of late anyway.
lines.zh: : 没事。反正也挺晚了。

lines.en: : But, I mean...
lines.zh: : 可是，我是说……

lines.en: scene rindormfortyfive16
: Are you sure?...
lines.zh: : 你确定吗？……

lines.en: : We spent the whole day together.
lines.zh: : 我们可是待了一整天啊。

lines.en: : Having you leave just because Otoha got her phone back is-
lines.zh: : 就因为 Otoha 拿回了手机你就要走，这也——

lines.en: : I was just the backup plan, remember?
lines.zh: : 我只是个备用计划，记得吗？

lines.en: : There’s no need for me anymore now that you’ve got her on the line.
lines.zh: : 现在你跟她聊上了，就没我什么事了。

lines.en: : I really mean it, dude. I can put the phone down for-
lines.zh: : 我说真的，老兄。我可以把手机放下的——

lines.en: : It’s fine. Don’t worry about it.
lines.zh: : 没事。别在意。

lines.en: : I’m sure I’ve got a million texts from Ami about when I’m going to be home anyway.
lines.zh: : 我敢说 Ami 已经发了无数条短信问我什么时候回家了。

lines.en: : We can just call it a night here.
lines.zh: : 今晚就到这儿吧。

lines.en: scene rindormfortyfive17
: Okay, but...
lines.zh: : 好吧，可是……

lines.en: : I really did have fun today.
lines.zh: : 我今天真的玩得很开心。

lines.en: : Even if you were just a backup.
lines.zh: : 就算你只是个备胎。

lines.en: : So did I.
lines.zh: : 我也是。

lines.en: : Here’s hoping your first choice won’t bail on you again next time.
lines.zh: : 祝你第一选择下次别再放你鸽子。

lines.en: : Yeah...
: Here’s hoping.
lines.zh: : 借你吉言。

lines.en: : Night, Sensei.
lines.zh: : 晚安，Sensei。

lines.en: : Thanks for spending the day with me...
lines.zh: : 谢谢你陪了我一天……

lines.en: scene black
I put my shoes back on and exit the room, taking a glance back at Rin to see if she was watching me leave or not.
lines.zh: 我把鞋重新穿上，走出房间，回头看了一眼 Rin，想确认她有没有在看我离开。

lines.en: She wasn’t.
lines.zh: 她没有。

$ rin_love += 1
{i}Rin’s affection has increased to [rin_love]!{/i}

else:
: If you want to talk to Otoha, it’s fine. I can-
lines.zh: : 你想跟 Otoha 聊就聊吧，我可以——

lines.en: scene rindormfortyfive18
: There. Dropped.
lines.zh: : 好了。放下了。

lines.en: : You literally dropped your phone.
lines.zh: : 你是真的把手机放下了。

lines.en: : Otoha can wait.
lines.zh: : Otoha 可以等。

lines.en: : You’re the one who spent the entire day with me, so the least I can do is give you my undivided attention until the night is over, right?
lines.zh: : 陪了我一整天的人是你，所以在今晚结束之前，我至少该把注意力全放在你身上，对吧？

lines.en: scene rindormfortyfive19
: You’re really smooth when you’re not tripping over your words.
lines.zh: : 你不结巴的时候，说话还真顺溜。

lines.en: : That only happens with cute girls. I’d say you should know this, but you’re always weirdly composed whenever you’re talking to them.
lines.zh: : 那只对可爱女生才会。按理说你该知道这点，可你跟她们说话时总是莫名其妙地镇定。

lines.en: : Like, right now for example.
lines.zh: : 比如现在。

lines.en: : You don’t seem nervous at all.
lines.zh: : 你看起来一点也不紧张。

lines.en: : What would I even have to be nervous about? I’m a backup date.
lines.zh: : 我有什么好紧张的？我是备用约会嘛。

lines.en: scene rindormfortyfive20
: A date’s a date, man.
lines.zh: : 约会就是约会啊，老兄。

lines.en: : You really think I would have spent all that time kicking your butt in all of those games if I didn’t like you?
lines.zh: : 我要是不喜欢你，会花那么长时间在游戏里把你打得落花流水吗？

lines.en: : I just thought you were really into schadenfreude.
lines.zh: : 我还以为你只是特别喜欢幸灾乐祸。

lines.en: : And how I opened up about the adoption thing- why do you think I said all that?
lines.zh: : 那我跟你说领养的事又是为什么？你觉得呢？

lines.en: : Because I kept asking you questions about it.
lines.zh: : 因为我一直在追问。

lines.en: scene rindormfortyfive21
: It's because I want you to know more stuff about me.
lines.zh: : 因为我想让你多了解我一些。

lines.en: : And I want you to tell me more stuff about yourself.
lines.zh: : 我也想让你多跟我讲讲你自己。

lines.en: : I think you might be underestimating how important you are to me, Sensei.
lines.zh: : 我觉得你可能低估了你对我的重要性，Sensei。

lines.en: : This sounds a lot like a confession, Rin.
lines.zh: : 这听起来很像告白啊，Rin。

lines.en: : Oh trust me, you’d know if I was confessing.
lines.zh: : 哦，相信我，我要是真告白，你会知道的。

lines.en: : I’m so bad at it that it’s almost laughable.
lines.zh: : 我告白水平烂得都快可笑了。

lines.en: : What I’m doing right now is looking into your eyes and...telling you that...
lines.zh: : 我现在做的，就是看着你的眼睛……然后告诉你……

lines.en: : Telling me what?
lines.zh: : 告诉我什么？

lines.en: scene rindormfortyfive22
: Huh...
: That’s weird.
lines.zh: : 好奇怪。

lines.en: : Did you change your hair or something?
lines.zh: : 你换发型了还是怎么的？

lines.en: : No. But I {i}am{/i} wearing a slightly thicker T-shirt today.
lines.zh: : 没有。不过我今天穿了件稍微厚一点的 T 恤。

lines.en: : You just seem a lot more attractive all of a sudden.
lines.zh: : 你突然看起来帅多了。

lines.en: : Even after making a fool of myself in the arcade?
lines.zh: : 就算我在游戏厅出了那么多洋相？

lines.en: : And after you couldn’t finish that last slice of pizza.
lines.zh: : 还有你连最后一块披萨都没吃完。

lines.en: : That slice belonged to you. I had four and you only had three.
lines.zh: : 那块是你的。我吃了四块，你才吃了三块。

lines.en: : I had four slices of pizza for breakfast. There was no way I was going to have four slices for dinner as well.
lines.zh: : 我早餐吃了四块披萨。晚餐不可能再吃四块吧。

lines.en: : Who has pizza for breakfast?
lines.zh: : 谁早餐吃披萨啊？

lines.en: : The same girl who feels suddenly compelled to kiss you.
lines.zh: : 就是那个突然很想亲你的女生。

lines.en: : Excuse me?
lines.zh: : 你说什么？

lines.en: scene rindormfortyfive23
: I don’t know.
lines.zh: : 我不知道。

lines.en: : It just...
lines.zh: : 就是……

lines.en: : It came out of nowhere.
lines.zh: : 它就这么冒出来了。

lines.en: : You’re still not nervous.
lines.zh: : 你还是不紧张。

lines.en: : Are you?
lines.zh: : 是吗？

lines.en: : I don’t know.
lines.zh: : 我不知道。

lines.en: scene rindormfortyfive24
Rin’s phone goes off again.
lines.zh: Rin 的手机又响了。

lines.en: And, in other news, I feel like something big is about to happen.
lines.zh: 另外，我感觉有什么大事要发生了。

lines.en: : Are you going to answer that?
lines.zh: : 你不接吗？

lines.en: : No.
lines.zh: : 不接。

lines.en: : Why not?
lines.zh: : 为什么？

lines.en: : I don’t know.
lines.zh: : 我不知道。

lines.en: : There seems to be a lot you don’t know tonight.
lines.zh: : 今晚你不知道的事好像挺多。

lines.en: : There is.
lines.zh: : 是啊。

lines.en: scene rindormfortyfive25
: If I had gone on that date with Otoha instead of you today, would you have been jealous?
lines.zh: : 如果今天跟我约会的是 Otoha 而不是你，你会吃醋吗？

lines.en: : Probably.
lines.zh: : 大概会。

lines.en: : And if she was sitting where you are right now, and the two of us were face to face like this, how would you feel then?
lines.zh: : 那如果现在坐在你位置上的是她，我们俩像这样面对面，你又会是什么感觉？

lines.en: : Also jealous but probably a bit aroused, too.
lines.zh: : 也会吃醋，不过大概还有点兴奋。

lines.en: : Right?
lines.zh: : 对吧？

lines.en: : Right.
: Hey, Sensei?
lines.zh: : 嘿，Sensei？

lines.en: : Yes, Rin?
lines.zh: : 怎么了，Rin？

lines.en: : I know Molly got to steal the honor of being the very first {i}person{/i} I kissed-
lines.zh: : 我知道「{i}我第一个吻{/i}」这份荣幸被 Molly 抢走了——

lines.en: : But how do you feel about being the first boy?
lines.zh: : 但做第一个男生，你觉得怎么样？

lines.en: : I mean, I feel {i}great{/i} about that, but...
lines.zh: : 我是说，我当然很{i}乐意{/i}，可是……

lines.en: : Is that what you really want?
lines.zh: : 这真的是你想要的吗？

lines.en: : Why do you care about what {i}I{/i} want?
lines.zh: : 你为什么在意{i}我{/i}想要什么？

lines.en: : Because you’re just as important to me as I apparently am to you.
lines.zh: : 因为你对我来说，就像我对你一样重要。

lines.en: : I want to say you’re just saying that, but watching you fail so badly all day makes me think it might actually be true.
lines.zh: : 我本来想说你只是在说好听的，但看你今天笨拙成这样，我觉得可能是真的。

lines.en: : It {i}is{/i} actually true.
lines.zh: : {i}是{/i}真的。

lines.en: : Then we should probably kiss before I get weird and change my mind.
lines.zh: : 那我们大概该趁我还没犯病反悔之前亲一下。

lines.en: : It might be a...good way for me to...
lines.zh: : 这也许是……一个好方法，让我……

lines.en: : To figure out...
lines.zh: : 让我弄清楚……

lines.en: : How I...
lines.zh: : 我到底……

lines.en: scene rindormfortyfive26
: Mnh~
lines.zh: : 唔嗯～

lines.en: And then it somehow happens.
lines.zh: 然后它就那么发生了。

lines.en: I don’t fully understand how things got to this point so suddenly, but...
lines.zh: 我不太明白事情怎么突然就到了这一步，不过……

lines.en: They did.
lines.zh: 确实到了。

lines.en: Rin doesn’t make much noise after the initial sensation of our lips pressing against each other.
lines.zh: 在最初嘴唇相贴的那一下之后，Rin 就没再发出什么声音。

lines.en: In fact, it’s the quietest kiss I’ve ever had.
lines.zh: 事实上，这是我接过最安静的一个吻。

lines.en: But, at the same time, it feels like everything freezes-
lines.zh: 但与此同时，感觉一切都凝固了——

lines.en: Which could also explain the silence if you were that dead set on documenting how things wound up like this.
lines.zh: 如果你非要把事情怎么会变成这样记录下来，这份安静也好解释了。

lines.en: The answer is probably simple, though.
lines.zh: 不过答案大概很简单。

lines.en: And I’m probably just overthinking it.
lines.zh: 大概只是我想多了。

lines.en: In front of me-
lines.zh: 在我面前——

lines.en: No, {i}attached{/i} to me, is a girl caught in a vortex.
lines.zh: 不，是{i}黏在{/i}我身上的，是一个卷进漩涡里的女孩。

lines.en: One who’s been giving out pieces of her heart left and right, but never forward.
lines.zh: 一个把自己的心左一块右一块地分出去，却从来没有往前递过的人。

lines.en: And I guess it wasn’t until the day was about to come to a close that this truly dawned on her.
lines.zh: 我想，直到这一天快要结束的时候，她才真正意识到这一点。

lines.en: So she dropped everything and drew out her bravery, the same way she did on the beach-
lines.zh: 所以她放下了一切，拿出了自己的勇气，就像那次在海边一样——

lines.en: Just this time, things worked out.
lines.zh: 只是这一次，事情成了。

lines.en: They worked out all too well.
lines.zh: 成得不能再成了。

lines.en: scene rindormfortyfive27
We break apart-
lines.zh: 我们分开——

lines.en: : How do you feel now?
lines.zh: : 你现在感觉怎么样？

lines.en: : I don’t know.
lines.zh: : 我不知道。

lines.en: : You still taste like pizza.
lines.zh: : 你嘴里还是披萨味。

lines.en: : Says the girl who ate seven slices today.
lines.zh: : 说这话的可是今天吃了七块披萨的女生。

lines.en: : Yeah, so I clearly know what I’m talking about.
lines.zh: : 是啊，所以我显然很有发言权。

lines.en: : Also, I might like you.
lines.zh: : 还有，我可能喜欢上你了。

lines.en: : Surprise.
lines.zh: : 惊喜吧。

lines.en: : What about Otoha?
lines.zh: : 那 Otoha 呢？

lines.en: : I can...like more than one person.
lines.zh: : 我可以……同时喜欢不止一个人。

lines.en: : I’ve told you that before.
lines.zh: : 这个我以前跟你说过。

lines.en: : I mean, I still like Chika, too.
lines.zh: : 我是说，我还是喜欢 Chika。

lines.en: : My brain’s all over the place.
lines.zh: : 我脑子里一团乱。

lines.en: : Then just stop thinking.
lines.zh: : 那就别想了。

lines.en: : Okay...yeah.
: I need your help, though.
lines.zh: : 不过我需要你帮忙。

lines.en: : Sure, just-
lines.zh: : 好啊，只要——

lines.en: scene rindormfortyfive26
: Mnh...
lines.zh: : 唔嗯……

lines.en: : Sensei...
lines.zh: : Sensei……

lines.en: And then it happens again.
lines.zh: 然后它又发生了。

lines.en: scene black
And again.
lines.zh: 又来。

lines.en: And again and again and again.
lines.zh: 一次，又一次，再一次。

lines.en: We kiss for what feels like a full ten minutes before finally stopping.
lines.zh: 我们吻了大概足足十分钟，才终于停下来。

lines.en: The bad side to this is that there is never even an ounce of tongue involved.
lines.zh: 坏消息是，全程连一丝舌头的参与都没有。

lines.en: The good side, though,  is that now I’ve finally confirmed Rin feels at least {i}something{/i} for me.
lines.zh: 好消息是，我终于确认了 Rin 对我至少是{i}有点感觉{/i}的。

lines.en: What that something is, I can’t tell you.
lines.zh: 那到底是什么感觉，我说不上来。

lines.en: Am I still the backup?
lines.zh: 我还是备胎吗？

lines.en: Does tonight mean I’m a priority?
lines.zh: 今晚是不是意味着我成了优先项？

lines.en: There’s no way of knowing without time working its magic.
lines.zh: 除了交给时间施展魔法，没有别的办法知道。

lines.en: Fortunately, right now it seems I have an endless supply of that.
lines.zh: 幸运的是，眼下我似乎有的是时间。

lines.en: So I can wait as long as it takes.
lines.zh: 所以多久我都可以等。

lines.en: I just hope it doesn’t take long...
lines.zh: 只希望不要等太久……
